scope: Standalone SVG files in exported directories
browser: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:160.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/160.0

renderAudit.scope: Image decoding and alpha visibility on transparent canvas only

limitations: Partial structural and path syntax checks, not complete SVG conformance.
No automated contrast, geometry equivalence, actual Drupal CSS or reference usage checks.
Forced-colour presets are simulations; the alpha audit does not test forced colours, focus, mask or palette-specific visibility.
Candidate replacements are heuristic; missing counterparts may be intentional.
Blocked and untested assets are not passes.
